Nearly every improvement to the compressor so far came from a specific real
post rather than from reasoning about it in the abstract, so this is the most
useful kind of issue you can open.

If the post is about a death, illness, job loss or disaster and it was
rewritten with anything other than its own opening sentences, say so clearly.
That is a release-blocking bug, not a quality complaint.
